properties.description: Over the protocol (an in-process client, call_tool and list_tools), with test-only registry entries: a deprecated tool still answers exactly as before but for the notice, and its description opens with the mark; a deprecated argument and reply field are marked where a client reads them; describe_schema marks a deprecated node type, property and edge type and lists every deprecation; a call that passes the argument, names or reads back the type, writes or reads the property, draws the edge type or gets the reply field carries the notice, and a call using none carries nothing new; a removed tool's old name is refused with what to do; the registry as built leaves tools/list equal to the toolsnap goldens; the registry names only what this build serves.
properties.name: tests/a_served_item_is_removed_only_after_a_release_that_announced_it.rs
